purpose: Deterministic exterior visual proxy for model QA and reference review. Not a photogrammetric reconstruction, BIM model or survey-grade representation.

location.source: Public landmark coordinate from secondary mapping; not a surveyed building-centroid or ground-control coordinate.

orientation.basis: Approximate east-west arrangement inferred from elevated photographs; confirm from a traced footprint.

overallWidthM.basis: Photographic proportion proxy only; not measured or derived from floor-area reports.

overallDepthM.basis: Photographic proportion proxy only; not traced or surveyed.

floorHeightM.basis: Visual proxy; published sources describe differing two-/three-storey configurations across periods.

geometryPolicy.footprint: Provisional stepped polygon; not traced and not survey-verified.
geometryPolicy.dimensions: Estimated visual proxy; must not be advertised as measured or accurate.
geometryPolicy.reconstruction: Parametric geometry informed by permitted photographs; no photogrammetry is claimed.
geometryPolicy.sourceAreaPolicy: Do not use compound area as building footprint or floor area. Published area descriptions differ; no reported area figure is used to scale this model.
geometryPolicy.dimensionsNote: The 84,000-square-foot historical figure is a secondary-source floor-area statement with unresolved definition; it is not a measured plan or ground-floor footprint.
geometryPolicy.surfacePolicy: Simple colour materials only; no reference image is used as a texture.

sourceRefs.role: compound orientation and broad massing cues only
elevated oblique facade, dome and loggia silhouette
roof blocks, wing arrangement and compound context

acceptanceGates: Exact GLB, reference-source and render hashes remain linked.
LOD1, LOD2 and LOD3 pass GLB structure and zero-degenerate-triangle checks.
The single stepped Plinth remains one connected manifold component.
Thirteen fixed views and per-image hashes are regenerated after model changes.
Topology warnings remain visible; no warning is auto-accepted without primitive-level review.
Roof/wing proportions, textures/UVs and real-world dimensions remain unverified until independent evidence is available.
